kind.instructions: Classify this slice brief (a bounded task handed to one worker agent) by the kind of work it asks for. Pick exactly one of the five kinds.

criteria.locate: find where something is — a file, symbol, loader, registration, or set of files, with no interpretation; the deliverable is a location or enumeration
criteria.understand: read and report on a surface without writing to it — a report, trace, or research write-up that establishes what something is or does
criteria.change-small: write to a single file, where a test or a diff mechanically checks the result
criteria.change-large: write to more than one file, or write anything that no test or diff can mechanically check
criteria.judge: design, review, decide, or compare — anything whose output is a ruling or critique rather than an artifact
